items.source: This implementation will render error as HTML views if the client explicitly supports that media type. It attempts to resolve error views using well known conventions. Will search for templates and static assets under '/error' using the status code and the status series.
items.translation: 此实现将在客户端明确支持该媒体类型时以 HTML 视图形式渲染错误。它将尝试使用约定俗成的规则解析错误视图，并在 '/error' 下搜索模板和静态资源，依据 状态码 和 状态系列。

items.source: More specific errors can be handled either using Spring WebFlux abstractions (e.g. @ExceptionHandler with the annotation model) or by adding RouterFunction to the chain.
items.translation: 更具体的错误可以使用 Spring WebFlux 抽象（例如使用注解模型的@ExceptionHandler）或通过向链中添加RouterFunction来处理。

items.source: For example, an HTTP 404 will search (in the specific order):
items.translation: 例如，一个HTTP 404将按特定顺序搜索：

items.source: If none found, a default "Whitelabel Error" HTML view will be rendered.
items.translation: 如果未找到，将渲染默认的“白标错误”HTML 视图。

items.source:
If the client doesn't support HTML, the error information will be rendered as a JSON
payload.
items.translation: 如果客户端不支持 HTML，错误信息将以 JSON 负载的形式呈现。

items.source: The "match-all" media type is not considered here.
items.translation: 此处不考虑"match-all"媒体类型。
